requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
GASTROENTEROLOGY PROCEDURE NOTE — 04/24/2025
Screening colonoscopy.
Prep: clear liquid diet the day before, split-dose; good prep.
Findings: two small polyps (3 mm, 5 mm) in rectosigmoid removed; mild diverticulosis.
Plan: resume regular diet; pathology pending.

PHYSICAL THERAPY — 03/13/2026
Mechanical low back pain after gardening, 3 weeks; no radicular signs.
Plan of care: 6 visits; core stabilization home exercise program; hip hinge training.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 06/15/2026
S: 56 y/o F, follow-up cholesterol and weight. Enrolled in a weight management program since November 2025 — diet changes and walking; continuing. Back pain resolved after PT.
O: Wt 76.3 kg, Ht 160 cm, BMI 29.8. BP 122/72.

A/P:
1. Overweight — continue weight management program.
2. Hyperlipidemia on rosuvastatin 10 mg daily; last LDL 180. Increase to 20 mg discussed — patient prefers to recheck first after lifestyle changes.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 07/06/2026
Dietitian follow-up. Patient began the program in April 2026. Reviewing her reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1500 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app — logging most days. Walking most days.
Adjustments: lower saturated fat for LDL (swap red meat for fish/beans 3x/week), portion control at dinner.
Follow-up 6–8 weeks.

no_concurrent_glp1.text:
LAB RESULT NOTE — 09/08/2024
Fasting lipid panel reviewed: LDL 180, HDL 41, TG 229 mg/dL. Pt confirms she fasted 12 hours. LDL remains above goal on rosuvastatin 10 mg — adherence confirmed; discuss dose increase at next visit. For future lipid draws continue a 10–12 hour fast.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 07/06/2026
Dietitian follow-up. Patient began the program in April 2026. Reviewing her reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1500 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app — logging most days. Walking most days.
Adjustments: lower saturated fat for LDL (swap red meat for fish/beans 3x/week), portion control at dinner.
Follow-up 6–8 weeks.

PHARMACIST MEDICATION REVIEW — 07/16/2026
Pt asked about berberine for cholesterol/weight and fish oil. Advised berberine has limited evidence and possible GI effects and drug interactions; not recommended with statin without PCP input. Fish oil OK.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/21/2026
S: 56 y/o F, follow-up weight. Continues the program; weight 74.5 kg, minimal change. Frustrated. Asks about medication.
Previously on liraglutide (Saxenda) in 2024, stopped after about 6 months due to nausea. Willing to try a weekly option with slow titration. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 74.5 kg, BMI 29.1. BP 113/76.

A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 29.1, with hyperlipidemia — Plan: start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects, slower titration given prior nausea on liraglutide. Continue program. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Hyperlipidemia on rosuvastatin 10 mg daily; last LDL 180. Fasting lipid panel ordered.
